name: 9router-monitor-pro
description: Track quotas, tokens, and multi-account status of 9Router AI providers directly in the VS Code status bar.
author: Minhtalent-dev

commands.title: 9Router Monitor Pro: Set Status Bar Display Style
9Router Monitor Pro: Set Tooltip Detail Level
9Router Monitor Pro: Toggle Tooltip Detail Mode
9Router Monitor Pro: Open Live Console Log
9Router Monitor Pro: Set Log Tooltip Limit
9Router Monitor Pro: Toggle Console Log Status Bar Item
9Router Monitor Pro: Set 9R Log Refresh Interval
9Router Monitor Pro: Toggle 9R Log Tooltip Detail Mode
9Router Monitor Pro: Set 9R Log Status Bar Display Style
9Router Monitor Pro: Set 9R Log Tooltip Detail Level

aiTokenUsage.logTooltipDisplayMode.description: 9R Log Tooltip content detail level: all (both KPI summary and transactions list), summary (KPI summary table only), logs (transactions list only).

aiTokenUsage.logStatusDisplayMode.description: 9R Log Status Bar display style: minimal ($(terminal) 9R Log), compact ($(terminal) 9R Log · 10.1K req · G3.8 🟢), detailed ($(terminal) 9R Log · 10.1K req · $980 · G3.8 7.2K/940 🟢).

aiTokenUsage.tooltipDisplayMode.description: Tooltip content detail level: all (both aggregate summary and account list), summary (aggregate summary table only), accounts (account list only).

aiTokenUsage.statusDisplayMode.description: Status bar display style: compact (balanced), detailed (full ratio + reset times), minimal (ultra-compact numbers only).

aiTokenUsage.authMode.markdownDescription: Authentication method: `auto` (auto-detect), `password` (9Router Dashboard Password), or `token` (Session / CLI Token).

aiTokenUsage.providersPath.markdownDescription: Endpoint path to fetch providers list. Response must contain `connections`.

aiTokenUsage.usagePathTemplate.markdownDescription: Endpoint template to fetch usage by provider ID. `{id}` will be replaced with provider ID.

aiTokenUsage.statusBarQuota.description: Default quota to display on status bar when no model is pinned.

aiTokenUsage.showLogStatusBar.description: Show dedicated $(terminal) 9R Log status bar item to quickly open Console Log.

aiTokenUsage.refreshIntervalSeconds.description: Interval (in seconds) to automatically refresh usage statistics.

aiTokenUsage.logStatusBarRefreshInterval.description: Interval (in seconds) to automatically refresh 9R Log Status Bar metrics, transaction history, and hover tooltip (minimum: 3s).
